plum.title: Ordinal Regression
plum.tparallelNote: The null hypothesis states that the location parameters (slope coefficients) are the same across response categories.
plum.tparallelConv: The log-likelihood value of the general model did not converge; the test is approximate.

plum.continues: The PLUM procedure continues despite the above warning(s). Subsequent results shown are based on the last iteration. Validity of the model fit is uncertain.

nomreg.lrtNote: The chi-square statistic is the difference in -2 log-likelihoods between the final model and a reduced model. The reduced model is formed by omitting an effect from the final model. The null hypothesis is that all parameters of that effect are 0.
nomreg.lrtEquivalent: This reduced model is equivalent to the final model because omitting the effect does not increase the degrees of freedom.
